title: Nicely made but…
text: Nicely made but…. This shower curtain is nicely made, drapes well, but I’m so disappointed in the color. I liked the amount of green that faded down into the darker shades as pictured in the posting. Mine has a white, very pale blue, then gray, and goes right into a little bit of very dark green that quickly turns into a color that looks so dark it’s almost black. When one views it, it’s mostly white, gray, and blackish green. Slight hint of green if you look closely. It may just end up as a return. Unfortunate!

product_metadata.title: RosieLily Christmas Shower Curtain for Bathroom Xmas Shower Curtains Red Green Christmas Fabric Xmas Bathroom Set with Hooks Colorful Baubles Bathroom Decor Holiday, 72" W x 72" H
features: Christmas Shower Curtain for bathroom: Made of 100% polyester, waterproof and a reinforced header that prevents tearing and ensures long-term functionality.

Xmas Shower Curtain: Reinforced top hem on the bottom prevents colorful shower curtain billowing keeping the water in and the cold air out. Super waterproof fabric is treated to let water bead stay on the surface, quick to repel and dry.

Christmas Gift: The Merry Christmas shower curtain in pine tree print is suitable for any type of bathroom furniture. Creative and unique baubles patterns make you enjoy your bath time. Standard 72''*72''size fits Most.

Convenient & Easy Clean: Easily fits any standard size shower/tub and works with straight or curved shower rods. 12 white plastic hooks easily change the holiday shower curtain ring hooks to match the decor that you like.

Multipurpose, not just a pretty shower curtain: available for different style bathrooms with rugs or stalls, camper, hotels, motels, college dorm. It not only can be used as shower curtains for the bathroom, or a liner for a cloth shower curtain, also can be used as kitchen curtains, bedroom curtains, window curtains, backdrop curtains, patio door curtains, door curtains, outdoor curtains, RV curtains, etc.
